inlines.text: 全新 Windows 电脑将 NVIDIA Blackwell RTX 显卡、CUDA 和 AI 技术融为一体，配备最高 128GB 统一内存，带来全新类别的 PC

blocks.text: 新闻摘要：

inlines.text: 新闻摘要：
NVIDIA RTX Spark 笔记本电脑即日起由 ASUS、Dell、HP、Lenovo、Microsoft 和 MSI 发售——后续还将有更多系统推出——将 RTX 加速和 NVIDIA 全栈 AI 平台带入轻薄、高端的 Windows PC，用于创作、游戏和本地 AI。
RTX Spark 提供最高 1 petaflop 的 AI 算力和最高 128GB 的统一内存——让 AI 开发者、创作者和玩家能够在本地运行前沿 AI 模型、渲染 90GB+ 的 3D 场景，并以超过 100 帧每秒的速度在 1440p 下畅玩 AAA 游戏，而这一切都在一台轻薄便携的设备上完成。
对本地 AI 智能体、创意应用和主流游戏的首日支持，帮助用户立即将 RTX Spark 投入使用——从使用 Adobe Photoshop 和 Premiere 进行编辑，到运行 Hermes 和 OpenClaw 智能体，再到借助 NVIDIA DLSS 5 畅玩包括
Gears of War: E-Day
和
NBA 2K27
在内的游戏。

blocks.text: NVIDIA 今日宣布 NVIDIA RTX Spark™ 笔记本电脑正式上市，将 RTX 显卡与 NVIDIA 全栈 AI 平台融于轻薄、高端的 Windows PC 之中，带来加速创作、沉浸式游戏和强大的本地 AI——由 ASUS、Dell、HP、Lenovo、Microsoft 和 MSI 陆续推出。

inlines.text: NVIDIA 今日宣布
NVIDIA RTX Spark
™ 笔记本电脑正式上市，将 RTX 显卡与 NVIDIA 全栈 AI 平台融于轻薄、高端的 Windows PC 之中，带来加速创作、沉浸式游戏和强大的本地 AI——由 ASUS、Dell、HP、Lenovo、Microsoft 和 MSI 陆续推出。

blocks.text: RTX Spark 将 NVIDIA 数十年的创新凝聚于一颗超级芯片，提供最高 128GB 统一内存和 1 petaflop 的 FP4 AI 性能，可在本地运行大语言模型和 AI 智能体。在一台设备上，创作者、开发者和玩家可以在熟悉的 Windows 平台上，在日常工作流程与新兴 AI 智能体之间无缝切换。

blocks.text: “RTX Spark 将 NVIDIA AI、RTX 显卡和 CUDA 的强大能力与 Microsoft Windows 汇聚于一台 PC，用于创作、游戏和运行个人 AI 智能体，”NVIDIA 创始人兼首席执行官 Jensen Huang 表示。“我们与 Microsoft 及我们的 PC 行业合作伙伴一起，为创作者、开发者和玩家带来新一代 Windows PC，专为他们今天所做的工作以及他们接下来将与之协作的个人 AI 智能体而打造。”

blocks.text: New Windows Computers Bring Together NVIDIA Blackwell RTX Graphics, CUDA and AI Technologies With up to 128GB of Unified Memory to Deliver a New Class of PC

inlines.text: New Windows Computers Bring Together NVIDIA Blackwell RTX Graphics, CUDA and AI Technologies With up to 128GB of Unified Memory to Deliver a New Class of PC

blocks.text: News Summary:

inlines.text: News Summary:

NVIDIA RTX Spark laptops are available today from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI — with additional systems to follow — bringing RTX acceleration and NVIDIA’s full-stack AI platform to slim, premium Windows PCs for creation, gaming and local AI.

RTX Spark delivers up to 1 petaflop of AI compute and up to 128GB of unified memory — enabling AI developers, creators and gamers to run frontier AI models locally, render 90GB+ 3D scenes and play AAA games at 1440p at over 100 frames per second, all on a slim, portable device.

Day-one support across local AI agents, creative apps and major games helps users put RTX Spark to work immediately — from editing with Adobe Photoshop and Premiere to running Hermes and OpenClaw agents and playing titles including
Gears of War: E-Day
and
NBA 2K27
with NVIDIA DLSS 5.

blocks.text: With the arrival of RTX Spark, Adobe is enhancing its industry-leading creative applications, including Photoshop, Premiere and Substance 3D, with NVIDIA TensorRT acceleration in AI-editing features. Photoshop and Premiere offer native RTX Spark support through beta releases available at launch, with Substance coming soon.

Code, Test and Deploy With One Machine
As AI shifts software development from writing code to directing agents, work often spans a laptop, a cloud AI model and a cloud virtual machine for testing.

blocks.text: RTX Spark brings coding, testing and prototyping onto one machine. Native CUDA support lets developers run models and agents locally, keeping locally processed code and context on their device with a path to deploy across more than 150 million NVIDIA RTX™ AI PCs and NVIDIA GPUs in the cloud. Windows Developer Config streamlines setup, while Windows Subsystem for Linux provides familiar Linux tools used in cloud development.
